title: Production order
summary: create a quantity-one manual production order from an existing finished item, existing components, an existing BOM, and an existing routing; verify the generated operations and estimated materials; release the order; issue material to the job shop; report the operation(s) complete; and confirm the finished item is received into the warehouse.

tokens.v: Nothing yet. A production order is built from master data that must already exist, and LN will not say at creation which of it is missing or wrong; it says so at release, at material issue or at completion. This phase reads the finished item, its component, the BOM and routing revisions, the warehouses and the stock before the order asks for them.

phases.route: Manufacturing ➔ Job Shop ➔ Production Control ➔ Report Operations

tokens.v: Reporting the last operation complete records the quantity produced and, depending on a parameter, posts it to inventory silently, not at all, or after asking. The order becomes

only when Warehousing finishes the inbound receipt, so the two statuses are a handoff, not a failure. The phase ends with an inventory read because the Manufacturing-side status alone does not prove the stock arrived.

blocks.text: What LN is doing. Reporting the last operation complete records the quantity produced and, depending on a parameter, posts it to inventory silently, not at all, or after asking. The order becomes Production Completed when reported and Completed only when Warehousing finishes the inbound receipt, so the two statuses are a handoff, not a failure. The phase ends with an inventory read because the Manufacturing-side status alone does not prove the stock arrived.
